prompt:
The attached image is the CHARACTER REFERENCE. Study it carefully. Produce a NEW sprite sheet of that EXACT SAME CHARACTER in the EXACT SAME pixel-art style, but performing walking and standing poses instead of sword attacks.

MATCH THE REFERENCE EXACTLY — same character, same proportions, same rendering:
- The same full-face bright red hannya oni mask covering the whole head, with white glaring eye slits, a fanged white grin, and two red horns swept BACKWARD.
- The same long ponytail with its color BANDING: deep indigo blue at the root, electric blue through the middle, bright cyan only at the tip. Do NOT make the hair a single flat cyan color.
- The same BROAD PURE WHITE sleeveless captain's haori with the torn ragged hem, worn open over the torso — not a small vest, not a tank top.
- The same black tracksuit jacket with acid-green and cyan racing stripes down the sleeves, sleeves pushed up to the elbows exposing deep brown forearms.
- The same black hakama trousers with the racing stripe down the outer seam, gathered at the ankles, and the same black tabi boots.
- The same black-scabbarded katana and wakizashi at the LEFT hip.
- The same deep brown skin tone on the forearms, hands and neck.
- The same chunky pixel resolution, the same 1-pixel dark outline, the same flat cel shading.

LAYOUT RULES:
- PURE BLACK background (#000000) everywhere.
- Poses arranged in a grid with WIDE EMPTY BLACK GUTTERS between them.
- NO grid lines, NO cell borders, NO boxes, NO ground lines, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers, NO watermark.
- Every pose COMPLETE and UNCROPPED — horn tips to boot soles, generous black space on all four sides, nothing touching an edge or another pose.
- All poses the same scale, side profile facing RIGHT, aligned to a consistent invisible ground level.

POSES — 12 total, in reading order:
1-6: a six-frame IDLE breathing cycle — standing relaxed, swords sheathed, subtle weight shift, ponytail drifting slightly between frames.
7-10: a four-frame RUN cycle with clearly distinct leg positions — front foot striking the ground, weight compressing down, legs crossing mid-stride, back foot pushing off — the white haori and the ponytail streaming out behind him.
11: standing alert, weight on the back foot, one hand resting on the katana hilt.
12: walking slowly, one foot forward, the haori settling around him.

STRICT PALETTE — ONLY: #000000 #0A0E1F #1E33D9 #2B6FE8 #35C6F4 #8FE8FF #8F1116 #E01F26 #C6F02A #6B8A0F #FFFFFF #4A5568 #4A2A1A #855434 #B07A4A.
